The path is divided into 12 periods, each lasting 4-6 weeks, and covers a range of topics from data literacy and data science to machine learning, deep learning, and data engineering. The path is designed to be challenging but not overwhelming, with a mix of theoretical concepts, practical exercises, and real-world projects to maintain engagement and motivation. Regular assessments and feedback mechanisms are built into the path to help the learner identify areas of strength and weakness, and adjust their learning strategy accordingly.

**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |

| 1 | EDX3413 | Managing Technical Professionals | edx | Foundational knowledge of different management approaches and conflict resolution. |
| 2 | EDX2890 | Teamwork & Collaboration | edx | Building on the previous course, this one focuses on teamwork and collaboration, essential for effective leadership. |
| 3 | EDX3423 | Leadership Program | edx | Introducing leadership principles and skills, this course provides a solid foundation for the learner to build on. |
| 4 | EDX3400 | Women’s Leadership Program: Leading Teams | edx | Emphasizing soft skills, this course helps the learner develop essential leadership skills, such as communication and conflict resolution. |
| 5 | EDX3417 | Leadership in an Exponentially Changing World | edx | This advanced course focuses on leading in a rapidly changing environment, helping the learner develop a more proactive leadership style. |
| 6 | EDX3283 | Oxford Leading Strategic Projects Programme | edx | This final course provides a comprehensive toolkit for leading strategic projects, incorporating the skills and knowledge acquired throughout the learning path. |

**How the path fits together**

This learning path provides a structured approach to developing leadership skills, starting with foundational knowledge of management approaches and conflict resolution. The path then builds on this foundation, introducing teamwork and collaboration, leadership principles, and essential soft skills. The final two courses focus on leading in a rapidly changing environment and leading strategic projects, providing a comprehensive toolkit for effective leadership. Throughout the path, the learner is encouraged to develop self-awareness, reflection, and metacognition skills, ensuring they can recognize their strengths and weaknesses, set realistic goals, and adapt to changing team dynamics.

learning_path:
**Learning Path**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX2909 | Principles of Electric Circuits | edx | Foundational course on electric circuits, covering math basics and circuit analysis. |
| 2 | EDX509 | Circuits for Beginners | edx | Builds on EDX2909, introducing circuit analysis methods and electrical measurement equipment. |
| 3 | EDX478 | Circuits and Electronics 1: Basic Circuit Analysis | edx | Expands on EDX509, covering lumped circuit models, abstraction, and intuition-based problem-solving. |
| 4 | EDX861 | Circuits and Electronics 2: Amplification, Speed, and Delay | edx | Develops the learner's understanding of amplifiers, energy storage elements, and real-life effects. |
| 5 | EDX1435 | Circuits and Electronics 3: Applications | edx | Applies circuit analysis to real-world scenarios, including filters, op-amps, and digital circuits. |
| 6 | EDX206 | AC and Switching Circuits | edx | Introduces AC circuits, RMS voltage and current, and handling non-sinusoidal sources. |
| 7 | EDX361 | Electromagnetic Compatibility Essentials | edx | Covers electromagnetic interference (EMI) and noise control techniques. |
| 8 | EDX981 | Electricity & Magnetism, Part 2 | edx | Expands on electromagnetic concepts, including magnetic fields, induction, and inductors. |
| 9 | EDX2786 | Linear Algebra I: Vectors and Linear Equations | edx | Introduces linear algebra concepts, including vectors, linear equations, and matrix operations. |
| 10 | EDX2180 | Linear Algebra II: Matrices and Linear Transformations | edx | Develops the learner's understanding of matrix operations, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors. |

The learning path starts with EDX2909, which provides a foundational understanding of electric circuits. EDX509 builds on this, introducing circuit analysis methods and electrical measurement equipment. EDX478 expands on EDX509, covering lumped circuit models, abstraction, and intuition-based problem-solving. EDX861 develops the learner's understanding of amplifiers, energy storage elements, and real-life effects. EDX1435 applies circuit analysis to real-world scenarios, including filters, op-amps, and digital circuits. EDX206 introduces AC circuits, RMS voltage and current, and handling non-sinusoidal sources. EDX361 covers electromagnetic interference (EMI) and noise control techniques. EDX981 expands on electromagnetic concepts, including magnetic fields, induction, and inductors. EDX2786 introduces linear algebra concepts, including vectors, linear equations, and matrix operations. | 6 | COU1613 | Instructional Methods in Health Professions Education | Coursera | This course focuses on instructional methods, specifically in health professions education, allowing the learner to apply their knowledge in a practical context. |
| 7 | EDX2145 | Shifting Your Teaching Online | edX | As the learner transitions to online teaching, this course equips them with the skills to deliver engaging online content and support students effectively. |

Each course builds on the previous one, providing a cohesive and structured learning experience for the new teacher. The path culminates in a capstone project, where the learner applies their knowledge and skills to create a comprehensive teaching plan.
